verdict.rationale: The only API-versioning signal is a /v1-prefixed endpoint (POST /v1/search), which implies a versioned REST surface. No deprecation policy, changelog, or version-lifecycle documentation appears in the evidence. The frozen suite and environment versions are about evaluation content, not API versions, so they don't count here. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, explicit API versioning documentation (version lifecycle, compatibility guarantees), and a changelog or migration guides.
